tools.name: search_altss_data_agent_docs
tools.description: Search across the Altss Data & Agent Docs knowledge base to find relevant information, code examples, API references, and guides. Use this tool when you need to answer questions about Altss Data & Agent Docs, find specific documentation, understand how features work, or locate implementation details

tools.name: query_docs_filesystem_altss_data_agent_docs
tools.description: Run a read-only shell-like query against a virtualized, in-memory filesystem rooted at `/` that contains ONLY the Altss Data & Agent Docs documentation pages. This is NOT a shell on any real machine — nothing runs on the user's computer, the server host, or any network. The filesystem is a sandbox b

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Report a problem with this documentation site so the docs team can fix it. Use when a documentation page is incorrect, outdated, confusing, incomplete, or has a broken example. This is for feedback about the documentation content itself — not for product support requests or feedback about this tool

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "query_docs_filesystem_altss_data_agent_docs" references sensitive artifacts (apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "query_docs_filesystem_altss_data_agent_docs" appears informational but accepts parameters (command) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: query_docs_filesystem_altss_data_agent_docs · Private data: query_docs_filesystem_altss_data_agent_docs · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: query_docs_filesystem_altss_data_agent_docs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: query_docs_filesystem_altss_data_agent_docs · Private data: query_docs_filesystem_altss_data_agent_docs · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: query_docs_filesystem_altss_data_agent_docs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
